## berth backup restore

restore an org from a backup (the restored org is berth's)

### Synopsis

restore an org from a backup (the restored org is berth's)

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_backup_restore/

```
berth backup restore <file|-> [--as name] [--identity|-i key] [--force] [--no-start] [--no-rehydrate] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth backup restore backups/acme-20260101-030000.tar.zst.age
  berth backup restore - --as acme2 < acme.tar.zst.age
```
